0022600025.text: The Atlanta Hawks (5-4, 1st in the Southeast, 4th in the East) host the Washington Wizards (4-4, 2nd in the Southeast and 0.5 games back, 8th in the East) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game, with Atlanta on a two-game win streak and 1-2 at home, and Washington coming off a one-game losing streak. Atlanta is without Jalen Johnson (ankle), Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Anthony Davis is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision. The Hawks lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 120-105 win in Washington on November 4, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
